lines.intro: Am I underpaid? Everyone wants to know, and nobody wants to say their salary. Payband answers the first question without the second.
lines.ana: Ana is an engineer at Acme. She types her salary. Her browser checks the enclave's attestation, encrypts the number to the model's key, and stores only ciphertext on NEAR.
lines.others: Her colleagues do the same. The contract counts each role, but the Staff Engineer group has only one person, so it will never get a band.
lines.close: The round closes. Every ciphertext goes to a model inside an attested enclave on NEAR AI Cloud, in one sealed request.
lines.bands: Only the bands come out. The NEAR contract accepted them because the enclave's signature verified, and no submission was left out.
lines.verify: Anyone can check that, right here in the browser.
lines.mine: And Ana finally knows where she stands. Her salary never left her browser unencrypted.
lines.outro: Payband. Know your worth, without showing it. Built at the NEAR Hackathon.
